2df4f7966a.q: How does StoreOne FlashSPAN technology enable 9x capacity increase with mixed flash and HDD storage tiers?
2df4f7966a.a: The 9x ratio combines one part flash with nine parts HDD, achieving hard drive economics with flash performance. The platform allows tuning the SSD layer to the HDD layer based on I/O patterns and application needs. By running an 80-20 rule where 20% of virtual machines consume 80% of infrastructure resources, less critical applications can run on HDD and automatically adjust when needed, with the ability to tune caching on the fly through telemetry.

10012f1376.q: How does StoreOne auto-tiering address hardware cost inflation and storage procurement challenges?
10012f1376.a: Auto-tiering, a core architectural feature from StoreOne's inception, automatically places data on the appropriate storage medium. With NVMe costs skyrocketing and HDD becoming more economical, customers can add a second petabyte of HDD for less than 100 terabytes of NVMe, averaging storage costs across tiers and extending infrastructure life longer without requiring full flash upgrades.
